description: Counts in volts between two limits on each trigger, with a separate count for every channel of the trigger input

params.text: Sets the voltage the count begins from and wraps back to, -10V to 10V
Sets the voltage the count wraps at, -10V to 10V
Sets how much is added at each trigger, -10V to 10V, a negative value counting downwards

inputs.text: A rising edge adds the inc value to the count for that channel
A rising edge returns the count to the start value; a monophonic signal here resets every channel, a polyphonic one resets only the matching channel

outputs.text: The current count for that channel, wrapping round between the start and end values
